meta.title: G&D Flooring — Premium Flooring & Renovations
meta.description: G&D Flooring is a premium flooring contractor specializing in hardwood, luxury vinyl, tile & stone, and bathroom renovations. Craftsmanship you can stand on.
meta.ogDescription: Hardwood, luxury vinyl, tile & stone, and bathroom renovations. Craftsmanship you can stand on.

hero.headline: Floors that *elevate* every room.
hero.subcopy: G&D Flooring brings craftsmanship, premium materials, and a meticulous eye to hardwood, luxury vinyl, tile, and full bathroom renovations — built to last and finished beautifully.

services.heading: A full catalog of flooring craft
services.subcopy: From timeless hardwood to a complete bathroom transformation — every project gets the same obsessive attention to detail.

items.title: Hardwood Flooring
items.desc: Solid & engineered hardwood installation, sanding, staining, and refinishing for warmth that lasts generations.

images.caption: Stair treads matched to the floor

items.title: Laminate & Vinyl
items.desc: Waterproof luxury vinyl plank and premium laminate — the look of wood with everyday, family-proof durability.

items.title: Tile & Stone
items.desc: Porcelain, ceramic, and natural stone — precision-set floors, showers, and feature walls with flawless grout lines.

items.title: Bathroom Renovations
items.desc: Full bathroom transformations — floors, tile surrounds, vanities, and waterproofing handled end to end.

about.body: We treat every home like our own. From the first measurement to the final sweep, you work with the same dedicated team — no shortcuts, no surprises.

features.title: Master Craftsmanship
features.body: Seasoned installers with an obsessive eye for level, seams, and finish.

features.title: Licensed & Insured
features.body: Fully covered, code-compliant work backed by a written warranty.

features.title: On-Time, On-Budget
features.body: Clear timelines and transparent quotes — what we promise is what you pay.

features.title: Spotless Cleanup
features.body: We leave your home cleaner than we found it — guaranteed.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.desc: We listen to your vision, measure the space, and talk materials and budget.

steps.title: Design & Quote
steps.desc: You get a clear, itemized proposal with samples — no hidden costs, ever.

steps.title: Installation
steps.desc: Our craftsmen install with precision, protecting your home throughout.

steps.title: Final Walkthrough
steps.desc: We review every detail together and don't leave until you're delighted.
